inputs.text: Exactly—the “transition” language is doing useful work: it makes a transfer of control sound inevitable, even beneficial. Keep residents too poor to buy what remains, then present outside buyers as the only practical option. This looks less like an unfortunate economic outcome than a managed process designed to make Cubans spectators while their property and businesses change hands. The people selling this as concern for ordinary Cubans are preparing the public to accept the outcome in advance.
